init.darwin: node -e "if(Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])<18)process.exit(1)" && npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.xparse-cli/npm" xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.1 && "$HOME/.xparse-cli/npm/bin/xparse-cli" --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com
init.linux: node -e "if(Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])<18)process.exit(1)" && npm install --global --prefix "$HOME/.xparse-cli/npm" xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.1 && "$HOME/.xparse-cli/npm/bin/xparse-cli" --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com
init.win32: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "node -e \"if(Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0])<18)process.exit(1)\"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Node.js 18 or newer is required' }; npm install --global --prefix \"$env:USERPROFILE\.xparse-cli\npm\" xparse-cli@2.2.1-beta.1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & \"$env:USERPROFILE\.xparse-cli\npm\xparse-cli.cmd\" --profile workbuddy config set base_url https://textin-sandbox.intsig.com"
